title: PiCrawler (Godot)
launch_hint: godot_host launcher → picrawler; the config must be in the launcher allowlist
description: The four-legged PiCrawler in the Godot host (godot_host/project/scripts/picrawler_body.gd). Sources marked oracle are god's-eye and must not feed a deployed brain (see sensor_legitimacy doc).

sources.name: imu
sources.description: sin(yaw), cos(yaw), forward speed, angular speed

sources.name: joints
sources.description: 4 hip1 + 4 hip2 + 4 knee, normalised

sources.name: joints_dyn
sources.description: [q(12), Δq(12)] — the joints stream + its per-tick delta

sources.name: camera
sources.description: forward raycast RGB frame (OV5647 optics), when vision is on

sources.name: compass
sources.description: sin(yaw), cos(yaw) — world-frame heading

sources.name: radial_compass
sources.description: body-frame outward direction (x, z)

sources.name: target_compass
sources.description: body-frame direction to the active target — (0,0) when none

sources.name: target_loom
sources.description: fraction of the forward raycast hitting the active target (looming)

sources.name: bucket_fl
sources.description: foot-contact bucket for FL (1 stance / 0 swing)

sources.name: bucket_fr
sources.description: foot-contact bucket for FR (1 stance / 0 swing)

sources.name: bucket_rl
sources.description: foot-contact bucket for RL (1 stance / 0 swing)

sources.name: bucket_rr
sources.description: foot-contact bucket for RR (1 stance / 0 swing)

sources.name: leg_id_fl
sources.description: constant leg id for FL

sources.name: leg_id_fr
sources.description: constant leg id for FR

sources.name: leg_id_rl
sources.description: constant leg id for RL

sources.name: leg_id_rr
sources.description: constant leg id for RR

sources.name: tgt_align_fl
sources.description: target-alignment bucket 0..3 for FL

sources.name: tgt_align_fr
sources.description: target-alignment bucket 0..3 for FR

sources.name: tgt_align_rl
sources.description: target-alignment bucket 0..3 for RL

sources.name: tgt_align_rr
sources.description: target-alignment bucket 0..3 for RR

sources.name: feet_y
sources.description: per-leg foot height — ORACLE: absolute world Y

sources.name: imu6
sources.description: body-frame specific force [ax ay az] + gyro [gx gy gz]

sources.name: feet_y_gravity_cmd_acc
sources.description: commanded-FK foot height on an accelerometer-only gravity estimate

sources.name: feet_y_gravity_cmd_imu
sources.description: commanded-FK foot height on a gyro-fused gravity estimate

sources.name: feet_y_gravity_cmd
sources.description: feet_y_gravity from commanded servo angles

sources.name: feet_y_gravity_fk
sources.description: feet_y_gravity via analytic FK from measured angles

sources.name: feet_y_gravity
sources.description: per-leg foot height below the chassis along gravity (encoder FK · accelerometer up)

sources.name: feet_y_ground
sources.description: per-leg foot height above the ground = feet_y_body + belly ToF clearance

sources.name: feet_y_body
sources.description: per-leg foot height relative to the chassis — the Markov-compliant twin of feet_y

sources.name: foot_contact
sources.description: per-leg true foot contact (1 touching / 0 airborne)

sources.name: ego_heading
sources.description: dead-reckoned heading integrated from the body-frame gyro

sources.name: vel_ego
sources.description: [v_right v_forward] body-frame velocity — SOFT ORACLE (world velocity projected)

sources.name: stride_v
sources.description: [v_right v_forward] estimated from stance-leg FK, IMU-fused

sources.name: slip
sources.description: re-afference mismatch: EMA of the FK-vs-IMU innovation

sources.name: beacon
sources.description: fraction of the frame that is beacon-coloured

sources.name: ground_clearance
sources.description: belly ToF: normalised distance from the belly to the ground beneath

sources.name: upright
sources.description: chassis up-vector alignment with gravity (1 upright, 0 on its side, -1 inverted)

sources.name: joint_torque
sources.description: per-servo PD command budget, normalised — not applied torque

sources.name: foot_load
sources.description: per-leg foot normal force normalised by body weight — the CoG sensor

sources.name: joint_load
sources.description: per-servo velocity-tracking deficit, normalised — the load proxy

sources.name: tilt
sources.description: sin(pitch), cos(pitch), sin(roll), cos(roll)

sinks.name: fl_hip2
sinks.description: ActionOut.accel drives the FL hip2 servo

sinks.name: fr_knee

sinks.name: rl_hip2
sinks.description: ActionOut.accel drives the RL hip2 servo

sinks.name: rl_knee
sinks.description: ActionOut.accel drives the RL knee servo

sinks.name: rr_hip1
sinks.description: ActionOut.accel drives the RR hip1 servo

sinks.name: rr_hip2
sinks.description: ActionOut.accel drives the RR hip2 servo

sinks.name: rr_knee
sinks.description: ActionOut.accel drives the RR knee servo

events.name: hit
events.description: graded reward — duty-cycled toward standing height
